name: demoday
description: Turn a codebase into a finished demo video: the agent drives the app on screen, narrates what it exercises, generates voiceover and an on-camera presenter via fal.ai, and renders the timeline with Remotion. macOS only.

interface.shortDescription: Record, narrate and edit a finished demo video of your software
interface.longDescription: DemoDay turns a codebase into a finished demo video. The agent rehearses the app through the demo-stage MCP server (web, macOS desktop or terminal), a deterministic runner replays the rehearsed steps while recording, narration and an on-camera presenter are generated via fal.ai and ElevenLabs, and Remotion renders the timeline. Supports 16:9 launch/tutorial/explainer videos and 9:16 Shorts.
defaultPrompt: Make a 60-second demo video of this project using the demo-video skill.
Cut a vertical Short from the demo in demo/<slug> using the demo-shorts skill.
